### Digital & Online Games

- **[Wordwall Hebrew Games](https://wordwall.net/en-us/community/hebrew/games):** Features over 10,000 interactive community-created activities, including vocabulary matching, verb conjugation, and quiz games.
- **[Jigzi](https://jigzi.org/):** Offers thousands of digital Jewish and Hebrew educational games covering fast-track reading, conversational Hebrew, and holiday topics.
- **[FreeHebrewGames](https://freehebrewgames.com/):** Simple online tools featuring memory matching, speed drills, and Hebrew number-dialing practice.
- **[Hebrew Mastery](https://hebrewmastery.com/games/):** Interactive drills for alphabet recognition, vowel points (*niqqud* ), memory cards, and speed reading.
- **[TorahGames](https://torahgames.org/game/):** Focuses on high-frequency vocabulary (*millim* ), root words (*shoroshim* ), and gematria.[[1]](https://torahgames.org/game/)[[2]](https://wordwall.net/en-us/community/hebrew/games)[[3]](https://jigzi.org/)[[4]](https://freehebrewgames.com/)[[5]](https://hebrewmastery.com/games/)

### Physical & Tabletop Games

- **[Shoresh Pop!](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:14703281962148447269,headlineOfferDocid:5270990074308231549,productDocid:5270990074308231549&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjO98_shbmXAxUvoCsGHTYKA8MQxa4PegoIAggACAAIJRAG) (The Fidget Games):** A multisensory fidget and card game designed to help students connect sounds to letters and decode Hebrew three-letter root words.
- **Classic Israeli Word Categories ("Stop" / *Atzer*):** A pen-and-paper game where players pick a random letter from the Hebrew alphabet and race to fill out categories like country, animal, plant, and boy's/girl's name starting with that letter.
- **Hebrew Memory Cards & Board Games:** Physical memory matching, Bingo, and flashcard games available via platforms like [Teachers Pay Teachers](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/free?search=hebrew%20games) or commercial retailers.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/hebrew-games/s?k=hebrew+games)[[2]](https://www.thefidgetgame.com/products/hebrew-wordpop)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KOXcC8UPnMs&t=98)[[4]](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/free?search=hebrew%20games)
